Mit dem Plus legst du einen Termin an. G: Use the plus to add an event. Enter a title, time and calendar. Location, note, repeat and alert are optional.

Ein Termin lässt sich als Kalenderdatei: An event can be shared as a calendar file (.ics) or as a QR code. LiCal sends nothing to the internet itself.
Kalenderdateien aus LiMail oder anderen: Calendar files from LiMail or other apps open in LiCal and can be added.
Alle Termine liegen auf diesem Gerät. Oh: All events are stored on this device. LiCal shares nothing without your consent.
Strg+N legt schnell einen Termin an. Str: Ctrl+N quickly adds an event. Ctrl+1 to Ctrl+4 switch to day, week, month and year. Ctrl+T jumps to today, Ctrl+Shift+T to a date. Ctrl+F searches, Ctrl+E opens the info window of the selected event. The arrow keys move through the calendar or move a selected event, Tab selects the next event, Delete deletes it and Return opens it. Ctrl+P prints, Ctrl+Comma opens the settings.

Wähle beim Termin, wann LiCal dich hinwe: Choose when LiCal should alert you, for example 15 minutes before. LiCal then shows a notification.
Hinweise erscheinen auch, wenn LiCal ges: Alerts appear even when LiCal is closed. A small background service set up during installation takes care of this.
